import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

def avg_pos(fn, name, n=5):
    # average several perception calls to reduce ~1cm noise
    ps = []
    q = None
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q = fn(name)
        ps.append(p)
    return np.mean(ps, axis=0), q

# Perceive nut center and handle grasp pose (averaged)
nut_center_pos, nut_center_quat = avg_pos(get_object_pose, "white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = avg_pos(sample_grasp_pose, "extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# Rigid offset from nut center to grasp point (world frame, nut not rotated during carry)
offset = grasp_pos - nut_center_pos

# Perceive peg
peg_pos, peg_quat = avg_pos(get_object_pose, "brown square block")

# Grasp the handle
goto_home_joint_position()
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Target: nut center above peg, so gripper target = peg + offset (keep same orientation)
target_xy = peg_pos[:2] + offset[:2]
hover = np.array([target_xy[0], target_xy[1], lift_pos[2]])
goto_pose(hover, grasp_quat)

# Insert: lower nut so its center goes down over the peg
insert_z = peg_pos[2] + offset[2] + 0.005
insert_pos = np.array([target_xy[0], target_xy[1], insert_z])
goto_pose(insert_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.08)

# Release and retreat
open_gripper()
retreat = insert_pos.copy()
retreat[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat, grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
